system.description:
MYRATHI

Body, memory and spirit cling to one another as tightly as mycelium clings to ancient earth.
You gain Advantage on saving throws against possession and effects that forcibly remove, displace or separate your soul from your body.

Prerequisites Level 10

Works automatically: advantage on saves against possession is pre-ticked by trait and offered against soul-displacing effects.
